# Ipile Earth Synergy Construction Limited

> Nigerian construction company building suitable, affordable homes with Compressed Earth Brick (CEB) and locally available resources. Using CEB reduces the cost of housing by 30-40% of the total walling cost per unit.

Registered with the Corporate Affairs Commission of Nigeria, RC No. 1461757. Clients include the Nigerian Navy.

Mission: To become the leading provider of affordable homes in Nigeria.
Core values: Innovation, Speed, Cost Effectiveness, Teamwork.

Office: Abba Father Estate off Estate 15, Estate 15, Redemption Camp, Lagos-Ibadan Expressway, Nigeria
Phone: +234 812 686 8754, +234 808 932 1462
Email: ipileearth1@gmail.com
Website: https://www.ipileearth.com.ng

- [Affordable housing in Nigeria](https://www.ipileearth.com.ng/affordable-housing-nigeria): how we make low-cost homes, what goes into them, and what we have delivered

- [Cost of building a house in Nigeria (2026)](https://www.ipileearth.com.ng/guides/cost-of-building-a-house-in-nigeria): published price ranges, cost per square metre and a worked example
- [Compressed earth bricks vs sandcrete vs burnt bricks](https://www.ipileearth.com.ng/guides/compressed-earth-bricks-vs-sandcrete-vs-burnt-bricks): strength, cost, speed and thermal comparison with sources
- [How to build with interlocking earth bricks](https://www.ipileearth.com.ng/guides/how-to-build-with-interlocking-earth-bricks): step-by-step guide
- [Services](https://www.ipileearth.com.ng/services): all five service lines
- [Projects](https://www.ipileearth.com.ng/projects): completed barracks, schools, churches and homes
- [About](https://www.ipileearth.com.ng/about): mission, vision, values and leadership
- [Contact](https://www.ipileearth.com.ng/contact): office address, phone and email
